title: ABAC DENY policies are in Beta
body:
ABAC DENY policies are in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types) in Unity Catalog. DENY policies can be used to explicitly deny the `MANAGE ACCESS CONTROL` privilege to prevent specified principals, including object owners, from performing access-management operations. They always take precedence over any grant.

For details, see [ABAC DENY policies (Beta)](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/abac/deny-policies).
